Subject: ClearGlass trial — post-call recap (access, owners, success criteria)

Hi Alice —

Great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment for the trial kickoff: 

1) Success criteria (your team):
- Ingest ~200k docs and run retrieval+generation against the private dataset; 95th pct latency < 700ms for 8k context average.
- Score of >= 0.75 on your head-to-head evaluation set for intent classification and extractive QA.
- No PII leakage in 200 random prompts (we’ll run the same eval harness).

2) Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): credentialing + SSO invite + IP allowlist configured.
- Week 1–2: bulk ingest + integration smoke tests.
- Week 3: evaluation run and scorecard review.

3) Ownership:
- Redwood: marissa_cole (sales) + karthik_iyer (solutions engineer) for SSO & API keys; soojin_lee for observability dashboard.
- ClearGlass: Alice Park (PM) + Ops (ops@clearglass.ai).

4) Access ask (what we need from you):
- SSO: SAML metadata or invite email for your Okta tenant (SAML 2.0).
- IP allowlist: List of public IP ranges for any egress/ingress you expect us to permit.
- Test dataset: one representative sample (anonymized) and the evaluation set schema.

For our side we’ll:
- Create a temporary API key scoped for ingest + eval (will expire in 30 days).
- Share SSO SP metadata and a short checklist for your IdP team.
- Upload a mutual action plan to the Drive (attached stub: mutual-action-plan.xlsx).

If this all looks good I’ll loop in engineering for SSO setup — can you confirm who from IdP/infosec should be included?

Thanks,

—Marissa
